THE URBAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY LAW No. 41 OF 1978 ENACTED BY THE NATIONALSTATE ASSEMBLY

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 15(1) of the Urban Development Authority Law No. 41 of 1978enacted by the National State Assembly I, Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Megapolis and Western Developmentdo hereby this Order vest in the Urban Development Authority with effect from today the lands morefully described inthe Schedule hereto being lands vested in the Urban Council of Maharagama.
PATALI CHAMPIKA RANAWAKA (M.P.),Minister of Megapolis and Western Development.
Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development,17th and 18th Floor,“Suhurupaya”,Battaramulla,12th June 2017.

Two allotments of land shown as A & B in Plan No. 3339 dated 24.01.2017 prepared by Licensed Surveyor Mr.B. U. S. Fernando situated in Maharagama Village within the Urban Council limits of Maharagama in the DivisionalSecretariat Division of Maharagama in the Colombo District, Western Province and bounded on North by ColomboAvissawella High Level Road, East by Balance portion of the same land, South by Balance portion of the same land, Westby Dehiwala road containing in extent of (0.40418 Ha.)
